title: fix(agents): explain prompt-cache drops with paired wire evidence
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Prompt-cache drops on continuation requests can be classified as `unattributed:continuation-wire-input` without enough evidence to compare the successful and missing-cache requests.

## User Impact

Operators get one bounded diagnostic line containing both the last measured cache hit and the dropping request. Request behavior, cache policy, and defaults are unchanged. Transports that do not expose encoded bodies leave these fields absent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the provider request encoder and its run-owned snapshot to record request bytes, a SHA-256 digest of the first 4 KiB, cache-key presence/hash, continuation-ID presence, and model/route hashes. Reuse the response callback for status, numeric processing time, and hashed values from a fixed header allowlist. The existing cache tracker retains the measured predecessor; no separate cache or state owner is introduced. Recovery metadata counts encoded attempts within a model call, not unobserved transport or cross-call retries.

Production delta: +88 lines (95 added, 7 removed; tests and docs excluded). The additional lines are required by the new diagnostic contract: the existing prefix fingerprints do not retain wire bytes, key presence, response metadata, or recovery counts. Existing fingerprints still own context-rejection and prefix comparison, so deleting them would remove working behavior. Raw keys, IDs, header values, and prompt content are excluded.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m4q35web1vr0td7apcwdxkwm`: baseline 45 tests passed. The new wire-metadata and measured-predecessor regressions then failed on unchanged production code for the missing diagnostic fields.
- Baseline synthetic measurement: 100 encoded 611,528-byte requests in 195 ms; process RSS 248 MiB.
- AWS Crabbox `cbx_264f8c6d8afa`: all 125 focused/sibling tests passed across seven files (`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` with `--maxWorkers=1`, 45.16 s including compilation). `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed all selected core/test type graphs, lint, docs, and structural guards. The combined command completed in 39m33s; source sync took 18m55s.
- Same-process AWS comparison, three alternating batches of 100 requests: median 2.727 ms before / 2.651 ms after per 611,528-byte request (effectively unchanged). New request metadata is 243 bytes before response metadata. Mixed-batch RSS ranged from 249–348 MiB; a separate tiny forced-GC probe found no retained-heap growth after 100 calls in either version. No memory or cache-hit improvement is claimed.
- Independent review: clean through P2 on the corrected candidate.
- [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38208075685) passed on `0a38d7573fdaa4e7814dd69f1d00c7349e66d66a`; workflow elapsed time was 656 seconds including queueing. All required CI and security gates were successful before squash merge `0d49b19ecfe2cf2a4b16f4f6f334552b41be771e`.

This proves diagnostic capture with synthetic transport data. It does not establish the cause of live provider cache eviction. No live deployment was performed.

<details>
<summary>Remote validation history</summary>

All runs used the task checkout at base `48d96b4e3b6f2bd79583e0fac438ab91a3cd57c7` with the indicated staged changes.

| Provider / lease | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blacksmith Testbox / `tbx_01m4q35web1vr0td7apcwdxkwm` | Baseline benchmark + three focused files | Setup failure: synced checkout had no dependencies. |
| Same Testbox | `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then baseline benchmark | Install passed; benchmark file was excluded by sync. Switched to an inline script. |
| Same Testbox | Inline benchmark + model-request-body, provider-prompt-state, prompt-cache-request-observer tests | 45 tests passed; baseline measurement recorded above. |
| Same Testbox | Model-request-body + prompt-cache-request-observer with new regressions and old production code | Both regressions failed on missing wire evidence; 32 other tests passed. |
| Same Testbox | Candidate benchmark, focused tests, changed gate | Sync timed out before execution. Lease stopped; switched to authorized AWS fallback. |
| AWS / `cbx_264f8c6d8afa` | Inline before/after benchmark + seven focused/sibling files | Seven existing assertions caught the new empty `requests` object on transports without evidence. Corrected the producer to omit unavailable evidence. |
| Same AWS lease | Inline benchmark; `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model-request-body.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/provider-prompt-state.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/prompt-cache*.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-stream-transport.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`; `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` | All 125 tests and the complete changed gate passed. |

No modules, exports, or test files were added. Both leases were stopped after use. The independent review was rerun clean after the empty-field correction.

</details>
